what: EMODnet beach-litter type codes -> material, for family 1.3's `beachlitter` store (plan E-092 D13). One entry per (reference list, type code) found in EMODnet_beachLitter_European_2025_unrestricted.zip (every data policy). 'plastic' = artificial polymer, including foamed plastic and polystyrene; 'non_plastic' = a material the list states; 'ambiguous' = the list does not decide the material. Ambiguous items are counted in their own channel and NEVER as plastic.
written: 2026-10-13, by rule from the reference lists below, every entry reviewed; the adapter REFUSES a (list, code) not in this table or whose name differs
no_machine_readable_source: No machine-readable code -> material map was found (https://nodc.ogs.it/marinelitter/vocab lists beach attributes, not litter types); this table is therefore ours, and says so.

references.OSPAR: OSPAR Commission (2010) Guideline for Monitoring Marine Litter on the Beaches in the OSPAR Maritime Area, Edition 1.0 (100 m survey form and its material sections)
references.OSPAR_1000: OSPAR Commission (2010) Guideline ..., the 1 km survey form for items > 50 cm (item names only; the form's material sections are not in the EMODnet file)
references.TSG-ML: MSFD Technical Subgroup on Marine Litter (2013) Guidance on Monitoring of Marine Litter in European Seas, JRC83985, master list of categories (G codes, by material block)
references.JLIST: Fleet D. et al. (2021) A European Threshold Value and Assessment Method for Macro Litter on Coastlines, JRC121707, the Joint List of Litter Categories (J codes, whose names state the material)
references.UNEP: Cheshire A.C. et al. (2009) UNEP/IOC Guidelines on Survey and Monitoring of Marine Litter, UNEP Regional Seas Reports and Studies 186, IOC Technical Series 83 (codes prefixed by material: PL plastic, FP foamed plastic, CL cloth, GC glass & ceramic, ME metal, PC paper & cardboard, RB rubber, WD wood, OT other)
references.UNEP_MARLIN: Cheshire et al. (2009) UNEP/IOC codes as used by the Baltic MARLIN project (adds OR, organic)
references.ITA: Italian national beach-litter list (ISPRA / MSFD Descriptor 10 national programme), IT1-IT59, ordered by material block as in the TSG-ML master list
